notes: Upstream is a local instant-return stub, so the delta between arms is the filter and the fabric it sits on, not the backend.
Run locally (no cluster network): B-1 measures the filter, not the fabric.
The baseline and classified arms are separate Praxis listeners because SPEC §2.2 makes `router` and `llm_d_sc` mutually exclusive in one chain.
manifest.scenario_description: Filter overhead at the proxy: baseline vs classified-miss vs classified-hit.

assertions.detail: captured 1000 measured records, expected 1000

assertions.detail: 0 requests errored or returned an unexpected status; budget 0; statuses {'200': 1000}
assertions.name: transport_errors_within_budget

assertions.detail: 200 warmup requests ran in a separate phase and contributed no measured record
assertions.name: warmup_excluded_from_window

assertions.detail: 0/1000 baseline responses carried x-llm-d-sc-* provenance (expected 0; a non-zero count means the baseline arm went through the filter and the delta is meaningless)
assertions.name: baseline_is_unclassified
